children: Bloomingdale's led Macy's portfolio in the second quarter, posting an 11.3% comparable sales increase and its highest second-quarter sales volume in the brand's history. The luxury nameplate's double-digit growth outpaced the broader company, which saw comparable sales rise 2.7% overall. Macy's flagship stores also showed strength, with Reimagine 200 locations delivering a 1.9% comparable sales gain for the fifth consecutive quarter of growth. Bluemercury added a 6.2% comparable sales increase. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Tony Spring credited the results to investments under the company's Bold New Chapter strategy
